name: MyAbacus ESS sign-in (capture + awareness redirect)
description: Authorised-simulation single-page MyAbacus ESS (Abacus ERP) sign-in for the abacus.texti1color.ch host. Faithfully reproduces the real Abacus OAuth login (username + password together on one screen, ABACUS diamond logo, Check Newsletter / Hilfe / Deutsch footer). On submit it records email + password to the tracker (page 1 = email, page 2 = email+password), then shows a MyAbacus-styled authenticator OTP step (page 3, code_2fa) before redirecting to the built-in 'Ooops, du wurdest gephisht' awareness page (learn.html) instead of the real Abacus login. Captures are stored in plaintext server-side — use only where the engagement consent covers credential capture, and purge after the programme.
placeholder_notes: Captures real credentials + OTP (DSG/GDPR-sensitive). Single page (username + password on one screen) matching the captured real portal; OTP step shown after submit unless mfa=0. Brand assets (ABACUS logo, newsletter/support icons) are embedded as verbatim data-URIs for pixel fidelity. learn.html ships with the clone — real-vs-fake example uses abacus.textilcolor.ch vs abacus.texti1color.ch.
